extensionDescription.message: Lets a local MCP server read and drive the browser.

browserActionTitle.message: Browser Control MCP: connection status and permissions

commandOpenPopup.message: Open the Browser Control MCP popup

toolOpenBrowserTabDescription.message: Lets the MCP server open new browser tabs

toolCloseBrowserTabsDescription.message: Lets the MCP server close browser tabs

toolGetListOfOpenTabsDescription.message: Lets the MCP server list every open tab

toolGetRecentBrowserHistoryDescription.message: Lets the MCP server reach recent browsing history

toolGetTabWebContentDescription.message: Lets the MCP server read page text and element snapshots

toolReorderBrowserTabsDescription.message: Lets the MCP server change tab order or group tabs together

toolFindHighlightInBrowserTabDescription.message: Lets the MCP server find text in a page and highlight it

toolCaptureTabScreenshotDescription.message: Lets the MCP server capture the visible tab

toolInteractMouseDescription.message: Lets the MCP server click elements, pick options and scroll

toolInteractKeyboardDescription.message: Lets the MCP server enter text into fields and press keys

toolExecuteJavascriptDescription.message: Lets the MCP server run arbitrary scripts in a page

popupToggleHiddenHint.message: This can make it vulnerable to prompt injection attacks!

popupToggleBackgroundHint.message: Maintains focus on the current screen, even during tasks.

popupPermissionWarning.message: Without full web access the extension cannot run. Grant it with the button below.

popupModeAllowlistHint.message: Only the tabs and sites on the list below

popupModeDenylistHint.message: Every page except the sites on the list below

popupToggleInheritContainerHint.message: Opens new tabs in the container of the tab in front

popupToggleAuroraHint.message: Draws an aurora over the tab while acting

popupToggleFocusHint.message: Outlines the target element while acting

popupToggleMarkHint.message: Marks the tab icon and title while acting

popupToggleBadgeHint.message: Names the action at the top of the page

popupSummaryNoBackground.message: No response from the background page

popupBadgeNotScriptable.message: The extension cannot reach this page

popupFeedbackMarkOff.message: The tab icon and title are left alone

popupFeedbackBadgeOff.message: The status badge was switched off

popupFeedbackContainerInherit.message: New tabs use the current container

popupFeedbackContainerDefault.message: New tabs use the default container

optionsInstallBody.message: The extension does nothing on its own; a local MCP server has to run alongside it. Run npm install && npm run build in the repository root first.

optionsInstallCodeSnippet.message: claude mcp add browser-control \n  --env EXTENSION_SECRET=<SECRET KEY> \n  -- node /path/to/repo/mcp-server/dist/server.js

optionsInstallDxtBody.message: Only needed to install into Claude Desktop in one click. Claude Code does not use it. Build it yourself with cd mcp-server && npm run pack-dxt — the DXT published by the upstream repository does not carry this fork's interaction tools.
